messages:
sara (design): dropping a tiny idea: 'onboarding role chips' — small chips above the members table for first-time admins: Viewer / Editor / Admin. click chip -> opens invite drawer with role prefilled. lightweight, less intimidating than the full matrix.
noah (pm): liking that. question: how do chips behave with bulk invites? we shouldn't hide the matrix.
sara (design): chips are shortcuts only. there will be a tiny 'Advanced' link in the drawer to open the matrix for bulk or complex perms. chips aim to reduce first-time friction.
kevin (frontend): straightforward: /invite?role=editor and focus email input. will ensure Enter/Space activate and aria-pressed used for state.
rachel (a11y): a11y notes: chips should be in a toolbar with aria-label="Quick role presets" and keyboard reachable. Make sure the selected chip has visible focus and 4.5:1 contrast. announce prefilled role on drawer open via aria-live polite.
audit-bot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.tools/onboard-chips/2405 build#5401
noah (pm): SSO nuance: if org enforces SSO, show an inline SSO label in the drawer header: small lock icon + text "SSO enforced" with tooltip "Members must sign in via {idp}". non-blocking but visible.
sara (design): tooltip copy will be concise. also add microcopy under chips for first-time admins: "Quick add a teammate. Use Advanced for bulk."
rachel (a11y): tooltip must be keyboard accessible and use role="tooltip" with aria-describedby. when drawer opens and SSO is enforced, use role="status" to announce. dynamic policy changes should use role="alert".
kevin (frontend): staging notes: two minor bugs spotted — duplicate announcement of drawer title in NVDA, and chip group needs a proper label. will fix and re-deploy.
offer (audit-bot): audit quicklink request: propose a small link "Recent role activity" next to chips that opens audit prefiltered to role_change&range=14d. preview card on hover with 3 anonymized entries.
noah (pm): permission guard required: non-admins should see a CTA to request audit access instead of landing on a 403. keep previews anonymized by default.
rachel (a11y): preview card must be operable by keyboard and read as a list; masked entries should include a "Show details" control for permitted users. also ensure focus isn't trapped.
sara (design): timeline: i'll update figma with the chip visuals + tooltip copy. aiming to push assets today. kevin, can you aim for a QA branch by Thursday?
kevin (frontend): yes — will prioritize keyboard + aria fixes and the SSO label behavior. will post preview link here.
noah (pm): thanks — we'll run a small A/B: chips vs no chips and header copy variants. measure first-invite completion and time. post results back in this thread. :rocket:
